<b>Bellhart</b> is a town and an [[Areas (Silksong)|area]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It is a town almost exclusively built from the numerous bells, both large and small, of the bellvein it resides within. Bellhart serves as a safe spot for pilgrims to rest at before continuing on their pilgrimage to [[the Citadel]]. 

== Description ==
Bellhart is a settlement that neighbours [[Greymoor]] to the east and [[Shellwood]] to the west, and is connected to [[the Marrow]] via its bottom bellvein. It is the last settlement pilgrims can rest at before their final ascent to [[the Citadel]] through [[Shellwood]] and the [[Blasted Steps]].<ref name="friendly-stop">[[Pavo]]: <i>"Welcome, welcome, weary pilgrim! Though glorious Bellhart may be past its finest shine, it still remains the last friendly stop before the Citadel."</i></ref>  

If the town is entered before defeating [[Widow]], Hornet finds its residents strung in Silk threads hanging from the ceiling, and all the buildings closed except for the [[Bellway]]. The town's name card appears as <b>Haunted Bellhart</b>, and the objective <i>[[SAVE: The Threadspun Town]]</i> is automatically gained.

After Widow is defeated Bellhart will be freed from the haunted thread. The shops will be opened, and a [[Wishwall]] will appear. The area's name card now appears as <b>Bellhart</b>.

Bellhart is composed almost entirely out of large bells, with larger bells being repurposed into homes for the residents, often referred to as "bellhomes". <ref>Pavo: <i>"In recognition of your noble efforts, and as one small step to solving the problem, I have decreed a grand gift should be given! A bellhome of your very own! A place to reflect. A bed to lay in. It's hanging up there at the top, beside our good pinmaster."</i></ref> The settlement has been built within the bellvein that runs through the core of [[Pharloom]].<ref name="map"></ref> This vein of gilded bells creates an effectively defended settlement, once granting its bugs a long time of peace.<ref>[[Shakra]]: <i>"This vein of gilded bells creates an effectively defended settlement. I can see it once gave a long time of peace to its bugs."</i></ref> 
 
<br><hr>
After completing the <i>[[Bellhart's Glory]]</i> wish and 2 of the following 4 wishes:
* <i>[[Silver Bells]]</i>
* <i>[[My Missing Courier]]</i>
* <i>[[My Missing Brother]]</i>
* <i>[[Savage Beastfly (Wish)|Savage Beastfly]]</i>

A new bellhome appears at the top of the area, which Hornet can access by speaking to [[Pavo]]. He will inform her that he decreed that Hornet shall be given [[Bellhome|her own bellhome]] in appreciation of her efforts and gives her the [[Bellhome Key]]. Hornet can furnish her bellhome through purchasing furniture from [[Frey]].

In [[Act 3]], Bellhart is greatly damaged, with many bellhomes in the background getting destroyed, though all interactable bellhomes are safe from the destruction.<ref>''[https://hollowknight.wiki/w/Bellhart#/media/File:Screenshot_SS_Bellhart_05.png Act 3 Bellhart screenshot]''</ref>

== How to Access ==
Bellhart is accessible through [[Greymoor]]'s western entrance after defeating [[Moorwing]].

Alternatively, Bellhart can be accessed before defeating Moorwing via [[Shellwood]]'s eastern entrance (if Shellwood was accessed via [[Wormways]] instead), or by saving five [[Fleas]] and travelling with the [[Flea Caravan]]. Accessing Bellhart using either of these methods skips the Moorwing boss fight, preventing the fight from happening until [[Act 2]].

== History ==
In the past Bellhart was a settlement founded on the path to [[the Citadel]] between [[Shellwood]] and [[Greymoor]], serving as a place for pilgrims to rest before continuing their climb. Some bugs would choose to not continue their pilgrimage and instead settled down in Bellhart indefinitely. <ref name="bell-hermit">[[Bell Hermit]]: <i>"Those bugs, cowering in their gleaming bells. Grnk. They claim a common calling, to serve the pilgrims as they make their path upwards. Such a crucial role they award themselves, surely worthy of praise! A sweet lie, of course. They, like their predecessors, are simply too weak and fearful to venture any farther. A settlement born from indolence."</i></ref> Over generations these residents would build Bellhart up into a bustling town and a safe haven for passing pilgrims. <ref name="bustling">[[Frey]]: <i>"Of once bustling Bellhart, only a few residents now remain."</i></ref><ref>Pavo:<i> "Welcome, welcome, travellers all! Rest your weary shell and revive your flagging spirit! Bellhart! Glorious, gleaming, and very very safe! Stay a while before you begin your final climb!"</i></ref>

The residents of Bellhart would devote themselves to the task of serving the pilgrims passing through, making the town into a safe place for them to rest before their final climb towards [[the Citadel]]. <ref>Bellhart [[Needolin Locations#Bellhart|Needolin dialogue]]: <i>"Gleaming rest... Almost there... Still alive... For the pilgrims, many... We serve, selfless... We serve, safe..."</i></ref>

Being built inside a bellvein afforded Bellhart easy access to bells of all sizes and kinds.<ref name="map">Bellhart [[Shakra#Maps|map]] description: <i>"A town built within the thick vein of bells that runs through Pharloom's core."</i></ref> Larger bells were used to create bellhomes that would house the bugs, while smaller bells could be used for raw materials, particularly silver bells.<ref> [[Silver Bells]] [[Wishwall]] text: <i>"When searching the bellveins carefully, you can sometimes find rare, silver bells. If we can salvage some, the material would be of great use!"</i></ref>

At some point during the [[Haunting]], [[Widow]] would find Bellhart and guide Silk inside the town, ensnaring all but a few bugs as a gift for [[Grand Mother Silk]].<ref>[[Widow]]: <i>"They shall join... Union upon your thread... A gift, for your waking. A world strung to serve..."</i></ref> Upon being freed from the thread by [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]], many residents would die, leaving Bellhart's numbers greatly reduced.<ref>Hornet and Pavo dialogue: <br><i>Hornet: "Your town seems returned to healthy form, good bug. I had some concern that, upon cutting you free, I'd find only husks"<br>Pavo: "Yes, well, many ahh... err... most of our residents did not fare so well... Still, it's no good to dwell on dark things! We shall build, and grow, and welcome! As is any good bellbug's task."</i></ref><ref>[[Pondcatcher Reed]]: <i>"Us few Bellharters are badly needing for fresh food, so my lone shell's carrying quite the responsibility."</i></ref><ref name="bustling"></ref>

== Special Rooms ==
=== Bellhome ===
{{Main|Bellhome}}
[[File:Screenshot_SS_Bellhome 01.png|alt=Hornet's Bellhome Hanging Above Bellhart|thumb|Hornet's bellhome hanging above Bellhart]]
Located above Scrounge's residence after the <i>[[Bellhart's Glory]]</i> [[Wishes|wish]] is completed is a locked bellhome. Pavo gives Hornet the key to this bellhome as a sign of appreciation after the completion of several wishes around Bellhart. The bellhome serves as a residence where Hornet can rest, and additional functions can be installed by purchasing furniture from [[Frey]] along with items Hornet finds throughout [[Pharloom]]. 

Available by default is a bed that functions as a [[Bench (Silksong)|Bench]], which Hornet lies down on if no input is made for 4 seconds while resting, or when loading the [[Save Data (Silksong)|save profile]] after resting on the bed.
{{Clear}}

== Creation and Development ==
{{Main|Cut Content (Silksong)/Areas#Bellhart}}
[[File:Bellhart April 2021.webp|thumb|100px|Bellhart in April 2021]]
Bellhart's main room was created around August 2017. Following its addition on the map, Bellhart continued to be worked on up until April 2021. In the April 2021 iteration, it was a much larger area than now, having extensive tunnel systems both north and south of the town. Both tunnels connected to two areas each, with the upper ones also leading through the [[Father of the Flame]]'s arena. In the town itself, the leftmost accessible bellhome housed [[Yarnaby]] instead of [[Relic Seeker Scrounge]]. 

By April 2022, Bellhart had its tunnels greatly reduced in size, similar to their current iteration. Bellhart also formerly contained the cut [[Cut Content (Silksong)/NPCs#Bugpipers|Bugpipers]] NPCs. Additionally, the [[Cut Content (Silksong)/NPCs|Caravantula]] could bring Hornet to Haunted Bellhart prior to his removal, and there was also a "[[#Bellhart (Fisher Room)|Fisher Room]]"; it required [[Silk Soar]] to access, making it a likely later development addition.

Bellhart was first showcased to the public in the February 2019 <i>Silksong</i> reveal trailer, which depicted the town as being brighter and livelier than its current state.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pFAknD_9U7c Hollow Knight: Silksong Reveal Trailer]</ref> A room within Bellhart's cut tunnels below the town could be seen in the June <i>E3 2019 Nintendo Direct</i> ending sizzle reel, showing Hornet pogoing off bells suspended on chains.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Zr9eAtwcYlo Nintendo Direct for E3 2019] on YouTube</ref> In February 2021's <i>EDGE Magazine</i> issue, another screenshot of Bellhart was shown, showcasing the cut [[Cut Content (Silksong)/NPCs#Pin Pilgrim|Pin Pilgrim]] NPC resting near Pinmaster Plinney's bellhome.<ref>[https://pocketmags.com/edge-magazine/february-2021 Edge Magazine February 2021 edition], p. 51.</ref> A May 2025-released screenshot also showcases visual differences.<ref>[https://www.ign.com/articles/hollow-knight-silksong-will-be-playable-in-september-2025-at-an-australian-museum Hollow Knight: Silksong Will Be Playable in September 2025… at an Australian Museum] on IGN</ref>
{{clear}}

== Trivia ==
* If the save is exited and reloaded while resting on the bench of Haunted Bellhart or during the Widow fight, there is a 40% chance for Hornet to be suspended in the air, strung by Silk threads.<ref>FSM <code>Webbed Hero</code> in <code>belltown.bundle</code>.</ref> Some text appears while trapped:
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* Bound together...
* Awoken together...
* Your Silk... our Silk...
* Your shell... our shell...
}}
* The [[Bellshrine]] in Bellhart is the largest of all the Bellshrines, and is the only one with the bell set in a background layer, where Hornet is unable to hit it.
* After defeating [[Widow]], if Hornet does not break the Silk on the Bellshrine after obtaining the [[Needolin]], it breaks by itself after a few seconds and reveals the lever.
* Hornet has a unique animation if she checks her map after lying down in the bed in her bellhome.
